coordinate_convention.wrapper: Observed uniform imported ref-root scale100; current character component scale .01 gives unit world bone scale. Ref component translations are divided by wrapper and scale set to one for unit reference calculations.
coordinate_convention.vertex_bone_local: boneLocalCm = inverseRefMatrix[bone] * importedRawVertexPosition. Inverse-ref removes the wrapper; do not divide these local geometry points by wrapper again.
coordinate_convention.reference_surface: Imported render LOD0 PositionVertexBuffer.VertexPosition / ref-root wrapper scale gives reference mesh-space cm.
coordinate_convention.connector: Frame1 identity. Frame2 uses child UnitRef relative to actual constraint parent UnitRef, then only its translation is divided by wrapper100. Source ref-pose BI.Scale3D100, AdjustedBodyScale=BI.Scale3D/(DefaultBI.Scale3D*componentScale), and MakeJointSetup multiplies GetLastKnownScale(componentScale); the /100 convention compensates the temporary ref-pose factor. Shape dimensions remain cm.
coordinate_convention.verification: Peak ActorWorld and render bone translations/rotations matched at approximately 1e-6 cm/degrees in saved probes; earlier 100x-packing hypothesis was not supported.

mass.caveat: Mass uses the existing longitudinal segment/terminal extent Length contract. Full box coverage may have a different Box.X length; mass is not redefined as box volume density.

contact_geometry.internal_segment: Nonzero child segment sets Direction, Length and midpoint; no unconditional parent extrapolation.
contact_geometry.terminal_support: UseDominantTerminalSupport=true selects actual largest imported skin-weight owned points; otherwise positive-weight support. Projection extent is measured, TrimTerminalBackwardsOverlap starts applied terminal capsule/mass extent at max(0, raw minimum), and front-side weighted transverse mean supplies capsule center.
contact_geometry.dominant_ties: Author support retains the first valid imported influence slot on equal weight. QA render-weight subset uses lowest skeleton bone index on maximum ties. These conventions are disclosed; no arbitrary weight threshold is used.

leg_strip_policy.prerequisite: Leg only, a nonempty dominant-owned support cloud and measured Width > 2*ContactRadiusCm; otherwise the existing one-capsule fallback.
leg_strip_policy.axes: X=existing segment Direction. In its transverse U/V plane, weighted covariance principal angle=.5*atan2(2*CovUV, CovUU-CovVV); Y=normalized principal transverse direction; Z=X cross Y.
leg_strip_policy.raw_fields: MinX/MaxX, MinY/MaxY, MinZ/MaxZ are min/max dot(imported bone-local dominant point, fitted X/Y/Z), in cm. Width=MaxY-MinY; weighted normal mean is separately logged.
leg_strip_policy.full_bounds_true: Box.X=max(2*Radius, MaxX-MinX); Box.Y=MaxY-MinY; Box.Z=max(2*Radius, MaxZ-MinZ); center=X*(MinX+MaxX)/2 + Y*(MinY+MaxY)/2 + Z*(MinZ+MaxZ)/2; rotation=MakeFromXY(X,Y).
leg_strip_policy.full_bounds_false: Thin-strip prior trial: Box.X=existing Length; Box.Y=Width; Box.Z=2*Radius; X center follows existing contact center, Y uses raw midpoint, Z uses weighted normal mean.
leg_strip_policy.terminal_caveat: When full bounds is applied, raw dominant support including negative longitudinal support is covered by the box; this can override the front-only terminal contact coverage while Length/mass/connector contract stays separate. This is assistant measured-coverage policy, not original-game geometry.

inertia.policy: RotationInvariantInertiaConditioning=true. Virtual uniform minimum-principal-moment floor; NOT isotropic inertia and NOT source-game metadata.
inertia.thin_input: Fresh ImmediatePhysics::MakeDynamicActorSetup on the current newly selected contact geometry at identity with the existing mass override and initial InertiaTensorScale=(1,1,1). 'thin' names this unconditioned candidate measurement, not an untouched original-game tensor.

formulas.effect: ImmediatePhysics bInertaScaleIncludeMass=true causes uniform s to multiply the ENTIRE body-axis tensor by s^5. All three eigenvalues scale by the same factor; minimum becomes Target. Eigenvalue ratios remain unequal/preserved, so this does not make an isotropic tensor.

inertia.preserved_by_conditioning: Mass override, contact geometry and center of mass are fixed during the inertia-conditioning step. Separately choosing full bounds can change geometry and its unconditioned CoM; preservation compares before/after conditioning for that same chosen shape.
engine_sources: C:/Program Files/Epic Games/UE_5.8/Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Private/PhysicsEngine/BodyUtils.cpp: ApplyMassPropertiesModifiers rotates to body axes and applies InertiaTensorScale
inertia.fresh_readback: Author re-instantiates bodies after assigning stored scale and logs ClothInertiaFinal actual principal values, mass, CoM and error. It tests positive eigenvalues and mass/minimum relative error and CoM error within technical QA .001. These QA tolerances are engine-test policy, not gameplay source values.
